title: [finding] `#16608` is cited 22 times across 7 files of shipped source and config while the number answers HTTP 404 — and two of them ride into `@objectstack/objectql`'s published declarations
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` execution PM seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357). ⛔ Filed unassigned and ⛔ ungraded — grading is triage's.

Surfaced while landing PR #19728 (card #18682): its round-7 prose **added** two `#16608` citations, `check-issue-citations`'s live diff-scoped half exited **2**, `Lint & Repo Gates` went red and **10 further gates went SKIPPED behind the stop**. Round 8 removed those two. ⛔ **This card is about the ones that were already there** — the diff-scoped gate cannot see them, so nothing reds on them and nothing will.

**Every reading below is this seat's own**, taken on `origin/main` and at PR #19728's head `c12c0ec26d`, except the one declaration-cell count explicitly attributed.

## The number does not resolve

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| `#16608` | **HTTP 404** |
| `#16805` — the commit's own PR, the obvious replacement | **HTTP 404** |

⇒ ⛔ there is no drop-in number. Re-probed at filing time.

## The population, measured on `origin/main`

`git grep -c "#16608"` over `packages` / `content` / `docs` / `scripts`:

| file | sites |
|---|---|
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts` | 8 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` | 5 |
| `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` | 4 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.test.ts` | 2 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/rls-check-membership-staging.test.ts` | 1 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/tsconfig.json` | 1 |
| `packages/plugins/plugin-security/vitest.config.ts` | 1 |
| **total** | **22 sites / 7 files** |

⚠️ **The pattern is a bare `#16608` literal.** ⛔ It is known to miss a citation wrapped across a line break, and it does not distinguish a docblock from a config value. ⇒ treat 22 as a **floor**, and re-take it with a normalised reader before acting.

## ⭐ Two of them SHIP

The nine sites in the two source files at `c12c0ec26d`:

- `engine.ts` — `:2206`, `:2235`, `:11279`, `:11469`
- `security-plugin.ts` — `:207`, `:1791`, `:2927`, `:3019`, `:3426`

Of these, **`engine.ts:2206` and `:2235`** annotate the `postHookWriteImageCheck` seam and reach `@objectstack/objectql`'s **published declarations**. This seat verified that `:2235` is the docblock on the exported member `postHookWriteImageCheck?: PostHookWriteImageCheck` of `OperationContext`. ⚠️ The per-cell count (**2** in each of `util-B_Rn613Q.d.ts` and `util-B_Rn613Q.d.mts`, under a normaliser that strips the leading docblock star and collapses whitespace) is the **round-8 implementing round's** reading, reported on #18682 comment `5786873880`; ⛔ this seat did not rebuild to re-take it.

⇒ a consumer reading the published types of a released package is pointed at a tracker that 404s.

## ⭐ Why the gate will never report this

`scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`'s default mode is **DIFF-SCOPED** — it judges only the citations a change **adds** (`addedLines`, `:590`). All 22 are already on `main`, so:

- ⛔ no PR reds on them,
- ⛔ and any PR that *edits* one **pulls it into the judged diff**, where it is then judged as added and goes red.

⇒ **the current state actively penalises the person who tries to tidy one up.** That is why PR #19728 was ordered to leave all nine alone, and why this must be its own change rather than a passenger on a product round.

⚠️ The gate does have a **census** mode that would list them (`--census`, report-only, never fails). ⛔ Whether anything runs it on a schedule is **NOT MEASURED** here — the gate's own header says 「⛔ NO WORKFLOW INVOKES THIS FILE」 for the live modes and describes itself as 「a tool a seat runs, not a standing caller」.

## What is NOT claimed

- ⛔ **No exit chosen.** Rewriting all 22 to name mechanisms, reviving the tracker under a live number, adding an allow-list for known-dead citations, or scheduling the census so the population at least stops growing are four different decisions. ⛔ This seat picks none.
- ⛔ **No cause established.** Why `#16608` 404s — deleted, transferred, or never issued — is ⛔ not measured. The gate itself refuses to collapse those four causes (`:71-88`), and so does this card.
- ⚠️ **The `tsconfig.json` and `vitest.config.ts` hits are almost certainly a different kind of thing** (a path or project name, not a prose citation). ⛔ Not inspected. ⇒ the **22** is a grep total, ⛔ not 22 prose citations.
- ⚠️ **Sibling, ⛔ not a duplicate**: the gate's header already declares large deferred populations (`release-pages` 103 sites, `package-docblocks` 2682 sites / 439 distinct). Whether `#16608` is inside a declared deferred surface or outside every one is ⛔ **not measured here** — whoever grades this must check that first, because if it is already declared, this card is a scoping question rather than a new finding.

## Dedupe words

`#16608 dangling citation shipped declarations` · `check-issue-citations diff-scoped blind to pre-existing` · `postHookWriteImageCheck seam tracker 404` · `editing a dead citation pulls it into the judged diff`
